data.summary: ddflow/infra/resources.py reports wait4 ru_maxrss as the command's peak, but a vfork/fork child's ru_maxrss includes the parent's high-water mark folded in at exec: `true` run via run_shell from a process that touched 600 MB reports 629760 KB (vs 15360 before; py 3.13 and 3.14). Gate evidence maxrss_kb is thus the ddflow process's own peak for cheap commands. Fix idea: when maxrss <= RUSAGE_SELF peak at spawn, report None (unknown) or mark it inherited. Root cause of B0cdef4bf3a (test side fixed there).
data.title: resources: maxrss of a command in a big process is the parent's inherited peak

data.body:
Fixes bug Bd36ace0ccb: ddflow/infra/resources.py reports wait4 ru_maxrss as the command's peak, but a vfork/fork child's ru_maxrss includes the parent's high-water mark folded in at exec: `true` run via run_shell from a process that touched 600 MB reports 629760 KB (vs 15360 before; py 3.13 and 3.14). Gate evidence maxrss_kb is thus the ddflow process's own peak for cheap commands. Fix idea: when maxrss <= RUSAGE_SELF peak at spawn, report None (unknown) or mark it inherited. Root cause of B0cdef4bf3a (test side fixed there). Found on fix-B0cdef4bf3a.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bd36ace0ccb --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bd36ace0ccb --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bd36ace0ccb: resources: maxrss of a command in a big process is the parent's inherited peak

evidence.command: uv run python inh.py (run_shell true before/after touching 600MB)
evidence.note: CONFIRMED: claim: failure is not load/py3.14 but the kernel folding the parent's rss high-water into a child's wait4 ru_maxrss. Refutation would be 'true' staying ~15MB after parent grows. Output py3.13: 15360 629760; py3.14: 13824 628224. Stress of the old test shape in 48 parallel procs on 3.14 did not fail (no load sensitivity); old assertion in a 400MB parent: again=437760 == heavy=437760 -> fails.
